about_the_game:
This Pack includes:

  • Marder, CLOVIS, FL 20, 105 mm (Rank 5 Germany);

  • Premium account for 15 days;

  • 2000 Golden Eagles.

The CLOVIS light tank was a joint development project by the German company Thyssen-Henschel and the French company Fives-Cail Babcock.

This light tank features a wealth of advantages, it is equipped with a French 105 mm cannon in an oscillating turret, and can fire a HEAT shell that can penetrate 400mm of armor! On top of this, it comes with a 5 second autoloader with 12 rounds ready to fire. Also in the turret is a coaxial 20 mm cannon, which will allow you to shred light vehicles and low flying aircraft. While its armor is light, its powerful engine will allow you to reach strong map positions early and comfortably flank the enemy.

A unique and versatile light vehicle, the CLOVIS will make a great addition to many Rank V lineups thanks to its great offensive attributes and scouting ability.

Note!

  • Refund is not provided if you purchase 2 different packs which include the same vehicle or you already have the vehicle from this pack!

  • Available for Linux, Windows and Mac only. You can't activate this item for the PSN or Xbox Live account.
